    margin:

      right: 1.7cm
    mainfont: "Segoe UI"
    section-numbering: ""
brand:
  color:
    palette:
      paper: "#FFFFFF"
      ink: "#22282E"
      ink-soft: "#5C666F"
      red: "#C10016"
      blue: "#0F4C81"
    background: paper
    foreground: ink
    primary: blue
  typography:
    headings:
      weight: bold
      color: red
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
    dev: "ragg_png"
    dev.args: {bg: "white"}
    dpi: 300
    fig-width: 6.8

  # A chunk that fails stops the render, so a factsheet over a lake it could

  error: false
---

```{r setup}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# What to set for a factsheet
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The one country the factsheet is about, as the repository codes it. It is
# taken from the environment variable FINCOMMONS_COUNTRY where that is set,
# so that one copy of this template renders every country:
#
#   FINCOMMONS_COUNTRY=NL quarto render esef-country-quality-factsheet.qmd
#
# Everything else -- the years, the issuers, what is ranked -- follows from
# the lake.
report_country <- toupper(Sys.getenv("FINCOMMONS_COUNTRY", "AT"))

# The path to the config file, whose esef section names the Silver layer.
config_path <- Sys.getenv("FINCOMMONS_CONFIG", "paths.yaml")

# The financial years shown, counted back from the latest the country has
# reports with facts for. A financial year is named by the calendar year it
# mostly falls in: a year ending on or before 30 June counts as the year
# before, so a year to 31 March 2026 is 2025. The sector factsheet uses the
# same rule.
n_years <- 3

# How many issuers the ranking shows, and how many of them the detail pages
# list finding by finding.
top_n <- 15
detail_n <- 10

# The points a finding scores, which is what the ranking is ordered by.
#
# A check of the module scores once per filing it fires on, whatever the
# number of facts it names: a filing with forty duplicated facts has one
# problem with its tagging, not forty. A note describes a filing without
# faulting it and scores nothing. The screens are this factsheet's own and
# are described in the settings below.
#
# The weights are a judgement of how much a finding costs a reader, and
# nothing more; they are set here so that a reader who disagrees can change
# them in one place.
points <- c(error = 3, warning = 1, info = 0,
            scale = 3, sign = 3, currency = 3, identity = 3, jump = 2,
            restated = 1)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The screens, which this factsheet runs itself
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The checks of the module look at one filing at a time. Some of the most
# telling mistakes only show when an issuer's filings are set beside one
# another, which no single filing can reveal, so this factsheet adds four
# screens over the headline figures of each issuer:
#
#   restated -- the figure a filing gives for the year before differs from
#               the figure the filing of that year gave, by more than
#               `restated_tolerance`. Restatements are legitimate (a new
#               standard, an operation discontinued) and score little.
#   scale    -- the same comparison, but the two differ by a factor of
#               `scale_factor` or more: almost always a figure tagged in
#               thousands where units were meant, or the other way round.
#   sign     -- the same comparison, with the sign flipped.
#   jump     -- within one filing, the figure for the year is
#               `scale_factor` times the figure the same filing gives for
#               the year before, or less than its reciprocal.
#   currency -- a filing whose monetary facts are mostly in a currency the
#               issuer does not report in in any other year.
#   identity -- a report whose own statement of the entity's name shares
#               nothing with the name of the LEI it is filed under, where no
#               other report under that LEI does either.
screen_concepts <- c(
  "ifrs-full:Revenue"                                 = "Revenue",
  "ifrs-full:ProfitLoss"                              = "Profit or loss",
  "ifrs-full:Assets"                                  = "Total assets",
  "ifrs-full:Equity"                                  = "Equity",
  "ifrs-full:CashAndCashEquivalents"                  = "Cash",
  "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities"  = "Operating cash flow")
duration_concepts <- c("ifrs-full:Revenue", "ifrs-full:ProfitLoss",
                       "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities")
restated_tolerance <- 0.01
scale_factor <- 50

# The lines a bank or an insurer presents and an industrial issuer does not:
# interest revenue under the effective interest method and the IFRS 17
# lines, as in the sector factsheet, and two lines of a bank's balance sheet,
# its loans to other banks and the deposits of its customers. A bank that
# presents its interest income under another concept -- Oesterreichische
# Kontrollbank tags RevenueFromInterest -- is found by its balance sheet.
# (Deposits from banks are not among them: a consultancy in the Dutch reports
# tags its bank loans so.) An issuer whose statements carry one of these is
# a bank or an insurer here, and the checks named after it are not counted
# for it. A bank's revenue is interest income, tagged as such, so a missing
# revenue line is what a bank's report looks like. And a bank's assets are
# neither current nor non-current: IAS 1 lets it present them by liquidity,
# and a group with a bank -- Österreichische Post with bank99 -- presents the
# bank's assets as a third block beside the two, so total assets exceed
# their sum by the bank, which the asset split reports as an error.
financial_concepts <- c(
  "ifrs-full:InterestRevenueCalculatedUsingEffectiveInterestMethod",
  "ifrs-full:InsuranceRevenue",
  "ifrs-full:InsuranceContractLiabilities",
  "ifrs-full:InsuranceServiceResult",
  "ifrs-full:InsuranceServiceExpenses",
  "ifrs-full:LoansAndAdvancesToBanks",
  "ifrs-full:DepositsFromCustomers")
exempt_for_financials <- c("MISS_REVENUE", "IMBAL_ASSETS")

# The point size of the text in a chart.
chart_base_size <- 9

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The design and the libraries
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# One design script for the whole package, in the templates directory at
# its root; a copy beside this template wins over it.
library(ggplot2)
design_file <- "r-corporate-design-functions-ggplot2.R"
design_path <- c(design_file, file.path("..", "..", "..", "templates", design_file))
design_path <- design_path[file.exists(design_path)]
if (length(design_path) == 0) {
  stop("The corporate design script ", design_file, " is neither beside this ",
       "template nor in the templates directory of the package.")
}
source(design_path[1])

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(yaml)
library(arrow)

if (!grepl("UTF-8", Sys.getlocale("LC_CTYPE"), ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  stop("The session does not run in a UTF-8 locale, so the names of issuers ",
       "and the typographic characters of this factsheet would print as ",
       "<U+00D6> escapes. Render with LANG=en_US.UTF-8.")
}

period_year <- function(date) {
  y <- as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))
  ifelse(as.integer(format(date, "%m")) <= 6L, y - 1L, y)
}

country_names <- c(
  AT = "Austria", BE = "Belgium", BG = "Bulgaria", CY = "Cyprus",
  CZ = "Czechia", DE = "Germany", DK = "Denmark", EE = "Estonia",
  ES = "Spain", FI = "Finland", FR = "France", GB = "the United Kingdom",
  GR = "Greece", HR = "Croatia", HU = "Hungary", IE = "Ireland",
  IS = "Iceland", IT = "Italy", LI = "Liechtenstein", LT = "Lithuania",
  LU = "Luxembourg", LV = "Latvia", MT = "Malta", NL = "the Netherlands",
  NO = "Norway", PL = "Poland", PT = "Portugal", RO = "Romania",
  SE = "Sweden", SI = "Slovenia", SK = "Slovakia", UA = "Ukraine")
country_name <- if (report_country %in% names(country_names))
  country_names[[report_country]] else report_country
Country_name <- paste0(toupper(substr(country_name, 1, 1)),
                       substring(country_name, 2))

# A legal name shortened for a table: the legal form abbreviated, and the
# rest cut to a width a column can hold.
short_name <- function(x, width = 40) {
  x <- gsub("Aktiengesellschaft", "AG", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("Gesellschaft m\\.?b\\.?H\\.?", "GmbH", x)
  x <- gsub("Societas Europaea", "SE", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(x))
  ifelse(nchar(x) > width, paste0(substr(x, 1, width - 1), "…"), x)
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The catalogue of checks
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

catalogue_file <- "dataquality_checks.csv"
catalogue_path <- c(catalogue_file,
                    file.path("..", "..", "..", "data", catalogue_file))
catalogue_path <- catalogue_path[file.exists(catalogue_path)]
if (length(catalogue_path) == 0) {
  stop("The catalogue of checks ", catalogue_file, " is neither beside this ",
       "template nor in the data directory of the package.")
}
severities <- c("error", "warning", "info")
catalogue <- read.csv(catalogue_path[1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                      encoding = "UTF-8") %>%
  filter(dataset == "esef") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = severities))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The Silver layer
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

yaml_paths <- read_yaml(config_path)
path_silver <- yaml_paths[["esef"]][["silver"]]
if (is.list(path_silver)) path_silver <- path_silver[["path"]]
if (is.null(path_silver)) {
  stop("The config file ", config_path, " names no Silver layer for esef.")
}

# arrow reads every parquet file under a directory, and a Delta table keeps
# the files it has replaced, so a Delta table read this way would count a
# row once per write. The factsheet counts rows, so it refuses one.
for (table in c("filings", "facts", "issues")) {
  if (dir.exists(file.path(path_silver, table, "_delta_log"))) {
    stop("The ", table, " table of the esef module is a Delta table, which ",
         "this template does not read. Write the Silver layer as parquet.")
  }
}
if (!dir.exists(file.path(path_silver, "issues"))) {
  stop("The esef module has no table of issues in ", path_silver, ". Run ",
       "fincommons.financialreport.esef.quality.update_silver_esef_quality ",
       "first.")
}

filings_all <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "filings")) %>%
  select(country, lei, filing, name, period_end, lang, processed) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(country = as.character(country))

countries_held <- sort(unique(filings_all$country))
if (!report_country %in% countries_held) {
  stop("The table of filings lists no filing of ", report_country,
       ". It lists ", paste(countries_held, collapse = ", "), ".")
}

# Which filings carry facts, over the whole lake: the comparison with the
# rest of the lake needs the other countries as well.
facts_per_filing <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "facts")) %>%
  count(country, lei, filing) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(country = as.character(country)) %>%
  rename(facts = n)

filings_all <- filings_all %>%
  left_join(facts_per_filing, by = c("country", "lei", "filing")) %>%
  mutate(facts = coalesce(facts, 0L),
         read = facts > 0,
         fy = period_year(period_end))

country_read <- filings_all %>% filter(country == report_country, read)
if (nrow(country_read) == 0) {
  stop("The lake holds no facts for any filing of ", report_country, ", so ",
       "no check that reads a figure can have run. Collect the reports ",
       "first: esef.update_esef(spark, '<paths.yaml>', ['", report_country,
       "'], contact='<you@example.org>')")
}

latest_year <- max(country_read$fy)
report_years <- seq(latest_year - n_years + 1, latest_year)
report_years <- report_years[report_years %in% country_read$fy]
period_range <- if (length(report_years) == 1) as.character(report_years) else
  paste0(min(report_years), "–", max(report_years))

filings <- filings_all %>%
  filter(country == report_country, fy %in% report_years)

# The name of an issuer is the one of its latest filing, since a company
# renamed in the period is best known by its present name.
issuer_names <- filings_all %>%
  filter(country == report_country) %>%
  arrange(lei, desc(period_end), desc(processed)) %>%
  distinct(lei, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(lei, issuer = short_name(name))

issues_all <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "issues")) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(across(c(country, lei, filing, issue), as.character),
         checked = as.Date(checked))

uncatalogued <- setdiff(unique(issues_all$issue), catalogue$code)
if (length(uncatalogued) > 0) {
  stop("The table of issues holds codes the catalogue does not describe: ",
       paste(uncatalogued, collapse = ", "), ". Run the checks again.")
}
if (!report_country %in% issues_all$country) {
  stop("The checks have not run over ", report_country, ": the table of ",
       "issues has no row for it, and a country no check has looked at is ",
       "not a country whose filings are sound. Run ",
       "update_silver_esef_quality first.")
}
checked_on <- max(issues_all$checked[issues_all$country == report_country])

issues <- issues_all %>%
  inner_join(filings %>% select(country, lei, filing, fy, read),
             by = c("country", "lei", "filing")) %>%
  left_join(catalogue %>% select(issue = code, severity, title),
            by = "issue")
```

```{r screens}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The screens over the headline figures
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# One filing per issuer and period end. An issuer that files the same year
# twice -- a correction, or a second language -- has its figures compared
# once, from the filing with the most facts and, between equals, the one the
# repository processed last.
primary <- filings_all %>%
  filter(country == report_country, read,
         fy %in% c(min(report_years) - 1, report_years)) %>%
  arrange(lei, period_end, desc(facts), desc(processed), filing) %>%
  distinct(lei, period_end, .keep_all = TRUE)

key_facts <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "facts")) %>%
  filter(country == report_country,
         concept %in% names(screen_concepts),
         is.na(dimensions), !is.na(value)) %>%
  select(filing, lei, period_end, concept, prd_start, prd_end, unit, value) %>%
  collect() %>%
  semi_join(primary, by = c("lei", "filing"))

# A fact is the filing's figure for its own year or for the year before.
# A flow has to cover a year, so that a quarter in the notes is not taken
# for the year; a stock has no start.
key_facts <- key_facts %>%
  mutate(days = as.integer(prd_end - prd_start),
         flow = concept %in% duration_concepts,
         prior_end = as.Date(paste0(as.integer(format(period_end, "%Y")) - 1L,
                                    format(period_end, "-%m-%d")),
                             optional = TRUE),
         prior_end = coalesce(prior_end, period_end - 365L),
         role = case_when(
           prd_end == period_end ~ "current",
           abs(as.integer(prd_end - prior_end)) <= 7 ~ "prior",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(role),
         (flow & !is.na(days) & days >= 330 & days <= 400) |
           (!flow & (is.na(prd_start) | prd_start == prd_end)))

# A figure tagged twice with two values is what DUPL_FACT_VALUE reports,
# and which of the two is meant cannot be told, so the screens leave it out
# rather than compare the wrong one.
key_values <- key_facts %>%
  group_by(lei, filing, period_end, concept, role) %>%
  summarise(values = n_distinct(value), value = first(value),
            unit = first(unit), prd_end = first(prd_end), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(values == 1) %>%
  select(-values)

compare <- function(a, b) {
  # a: the later statement, b: the earlier one.
  ratio <- abs(a) / abs(b)
  case_when(
    a == b ~ NA_character_,
    a != 0 & b != 0 & sign(a) != sign(b) ~ "sign",
    a != 0 & b != 0 & (ratio >= scale_factor | ratio <= 1 / scale_factor)
      ~ "scale",
    abs(a - b) / pmax(abs(a), abs(b)) > restated_tolerance ~ "restated",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)
}

# What a filing says of the year before, against what the filing of that
# year said of it.
comparatives <- key_values %>%
  filter(role == "prior") %>%
  inner_join(key_values %>%
               filter(role == "current") %>%
               select(lei, concept, prd_end, earlier_filing = filing,
                      earlier_value = value, earlier_unit = unit),
             by = c("lei", "concept", "prd_end")) %>%
  filter(unit == earlier_unit) %>%
  mutate(kind = compare(value, earlier_value)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kind))

# Within one filing, the year against the year before.
jumps <- key_values %>%
  filter(role == "current") %>%
  inner_join(key_values %>%
               filter(role == "prior") %>%
               select(filing, concept, prior_value = value, prior_unit = unit),
             by = c("filing", "concept")) %>%
  filter(unit == prior_unit, value != 0, prior_value != 0,
         concept %in% c("ifrs-full:Revenue", "ifrs-full:Assets",
                        "ifrs-full:Equity")) %>%
  mutate(ratio = abs(value / prior_value)) %>%
  filter(ratio >= scale_factor | ratio <= 1 / scale_factor)

# The currency a filing reports in, as the one most of its monetary facts
# are in, and the filings whose currency the issuer uses in no other year.
currencies <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "facts")) %>%
  filter(country == report_country, grepl("^iso4217:", unit)) %>%
  count(lei, filing, unit) %>%
  collect() %>%
  semi_join(primary, by = c("lei", "filing")) %>%
  arrange(filing, desc(n)) %>%
  distinct(filing, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(currency = sub("^iso4217:", "", unit))
# The issuer's usual currency is the one most of its reports are in; a
# report in another is a break only where the usual one is a clear majority,
# so an issuer that moved its presentation currency once is not flagged
# twice.
currency_breaks <- currencies %>%
  add_count(lei, name = "reports") %>%
  add_count(lei, currency, name = "times") %>%
  group_by(lei) %>%
  mutate(usual = currency[which.max(times)],
         usual_times = max(times)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(currency != usual, usual_times > times, usual_times >= 2)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Whose report it is
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A report states the name of the entity it is the report of. Where that
# name shares nothing with the name the repository holds for the LEI it was
# filed under, and no other report filed under the LEI does either, the
# report is filed under someone else's LEI: a filing agent's test report
# filed under the agent's own, or an issuer's report filed under the LEI of
# the service that submitted it. A company that has been renamed states its
# old name in its old reports and its new one in its new, so the LEI test
# lets it pass.
name_stop_words <- c("ag", "nv", "se", "plc", "sa", "spa", "gmbh", "kg", "bv",
                     "the", "und", "and", "for", "fur", "der", "die", "das",
                     "des", "holding", "holdings", "group", "gruppe",
                     "aktiengesellschaft", "international", "limited", "ltd",
                     "inc", "company", "beteiligungs", "europe", "european")
plain <- function(x) {
  x <- chartr("ÄÖÜäöüßÉéÈèÁáÀàÓóÍíÚúÇçÑñ", "AOUaousEeEeAaAaOoIiUuCcNn", x)
  tolower(iconv(x, to = "ASCII", sub = " "))
}
name_tokens <- function(x) {
  lapply(strsplit(gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", " ", plain(x)), " "),
         function(t) setdiff(t[nchar(t) >= 3], name_stop_words))
}
# Two names agree where a word of one is in the other, run together so that
# "LinzTextil" is "Linz Textil", or where a word of one is the initials of
# the other, so that "SBO" is "Schoeller-Bleckmann Oilfield".
names_agree <- function(a, b) {
  ta <- name_tokens(a)
  tb <- name_tokens(b)
  sa <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", plain(a))
  sb <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", plain(b))
  mapply(function(x, y, p, q) {
    if (length(x) == 0 || length(y) == 0) return(NA)
    ix <- paste(substr(x, 1, 1), collapse = "")
    iy <- paste(substr(y, 1, 1), collapse = "")
    any(vapply(x, function(t) grepl(t, q, fixed = TRUE), logical(1))) ||
      any(vapply(y, function(t) grepl(t, p, fixed = TRUE), logical(1))) ||
      any(startsWith(iy, x)) || any(startsWith(ix, y))
  }, ta, tb, sa, sb, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
stated_names <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "facts")) %>%
  filter(country == report_country,
         concept == "ifrs-full:NameOfReportingEntityOrOtherMeansOfIdentification",
         is.na(dimensions), !is.na(text)) %>%
  select(filing, stated = text) %>%
  collect() %>%
  distinct(filing, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(stated = gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(stated)))
identity <- filings_all %>%
  filter(country == report_country) %>%
  select(lei, filing, name) %>%
  inner_join(stated_names, by = "filing") %>%
  mutate(agree = names_agree(name, stated)) %>%
  group_by(lei) %>%
  mutate(lei_agrees = any(agree %in% TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(agree %in% FALSE, !lei_agrees)

money <- function(x, unit) {
  ccy <- sub("^iso4217:", "", unit)
  m <- abs(x) / 1e6
  txt <- ifelse(m >= 1, formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 1,
                                big.mark = ","),
                formatC(x / 1e3, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
  paste(ccy, txt, ifelse(m >= 1, "m", "k"))
}

screen_rows <- bind_rows(
  comparatives %>%
    transmute(lei, filing, kind, concept,
              detail = paste0(screen_concepts[concept], " ", format(prd_end, "%Y"),
                              ": ", money(value, unit), " here, ",
                              money(earlier_value, unit), " as first filed")),
  jumps %>%
    transmute(lei, filing, kind = "jump", concept,
              detail = paste0(screen_concepts[concept], ": ",
                              money(value, unit), " against ",
                              money(prior_value, unit), " the year before")),
  currency_breaks %>%
    transmute(lei, filing, kind = "currency", concept = NA_character_,
              detail = paste0("Reported in ", currency, "; the issuer's other ",
                              "filings are in ", usual)),
  identity %>%
    transmute(lei, filing, kind = "identity", concept = NA_character_,
              detail = paste0("The report names itself ",
                              substr(stated, 1, 60), "; the LEI is ", name)))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# How far out an imbalance is
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The checks of the module say that two sides of a statement disagree, not by
# how much, and a gap of a tenth of a percent is a different thing to read
# for than one of half the balance sheet. The figures are read the way the
# checks read them -- the report's own period, no dimensions, the lowest of
# two values tagged for one concept -- so that the size shown is the size of
# the gap the check found.
imbalance_concepts <- c(
  assets = "ifrs-full:Assets",
  current_assets = "ifrs-full:CurrentAssets",
  noncurrent_assets = "ifrs-full:NoncurrentAssets",
  held_for_sale = "ifrs-full:NoncurrentAssetsOrDisposalGroupsClassifiedAsHeldForSaleOrAsHeldForDistributionToOwners",
  held_for_sale_2 = "ifrs-full:NoncurrentAssetsOrDisposalGroupsClassifiedAsHeldForSale",
  equity = "ifrs-full:Equity",
  liabilities = "ifrs-full:Liabilities",
  revenue = "ifrs-full:Revenue",
  revenue_2 = "ifrs-full:RevenueFromContractsWithCustomers",
  cost_of_sales = "ifrs-full:CostOfSales",
  gross_profit = "ifrs-full:GrossProfit",
  pretax = "ifrs-full:ProfitLossBeforeTax",
  income_tax = "ifrs-full:IncomeTaxExpenseContinuingOperations",
  profit = "ifrs-full:ProfitLoss",
  profit_discontinued = "ifrs-full:ProfitLossFromDiscontinuedOperations",
  operating = "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities",
  investing = "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInInvestingActivities",
  financing = "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInFinancingActivities",
  cash_change_before_fx = "ifrs-full:IncreaseDecreaseInCashAndCashEquivalentsBeforeEffectOfExchangeRateChanges",
  cash_change = "ifrs-full:IncreaseDecreaseInCashAndCashEquivalents",
  fx_effect = "ifrs-full:EffectOfExchangeRateChangesOnCashAndCashEquivalents")
imbalance_filings <- issues_all %>%
  filter(country == report_country, startsWith(issue, "IMBAL_")) %>%
  distinct(filing, issue)
imbalance_figures <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "facts")) %>%
  filter(country == report_country, filing %in% unique(imbalance_filings$filing),
         concept %in% imbalance_concepts, is.na(dimensions), !is.na(value),
         prd_end == period_end) %>%
  select(filing, concept, prd_start, prd_end, unit, value) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(is.na(prd_start) |
           between(as.integer(prd_end - prd_start), 340L, 380L)) %>%
  group_by(filing, concept) %>%
  summarise(value = min(value), unit = first(unit), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(key = names(imbalance_concepts)[match(concept, imbalance_concepts)])
figure <- function(key) {
  imbalance_figures %>% filter(.data$key == !!key) %>%
    select(filing, !!key := value)
}
imbalance_wide <- Reduce(function(a, b) left_join(a, b, by = "filing"),
                         lapply(names(imbalance_concepts), figure),
                         imbalance_figures %>%
                           filter(startsWith(unit, "iso4217:")) %>%
                           count(filing, unit) %>% arrange(filing, desc(n)) %>%
                           distinct(filing, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
                           select(filing, unit)) %>%
  mutate(revenue = coalesce(revenue, revenue_2),
         held_for_sale = coalesce(held_for_sale, held_for_sale_2),
         before_fx = coalesce(cash_change_before_fx,
                              cash_change - coalesce(fx_effect, 0)),
         flows = operating + investing + financing)
fmt_share <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x >= 10, formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0),
         ifelse(x >= 1, formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 1),
                formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2)))
}
gap_text <- function(left, right, gap, scale, scale_name, unit) {
  ifelse(is.na(gap), NA_character_,
         paste0(left, ", ", right, ": a gap of ", money(gap, unit),
                ifelse(is.na(scale) | scale == 0, "",
                       paste0(", ", fmt_share(abs(gap) / abs(scale) * 100),
                              " % of ", scale_name))))
}
imbalance_detail <- imbalance_filings %>%
  inner_join(imbalance_wide, by = "filing") %>%
  mutate(detail = case_when(
    issue == "IMBAL_ASSETS" ~ gap_text(
      paste("Total assets", money(assets, unit)),
      paste("current and non-current", money(current_assets + noncurrent_assets, unit)),
      assets - current_assets - noncurrent_assets, assets, "total assets", unit),
    issue == "IMBAL_BALANCE_SHEET" ~ gap_text(
      paste("Total assets", money(assets, unit)),
      paste("equity and liabilities", money(equity + liabilities, unit)),
      assets - equity - liabilities, assets, "total assets", unit),
    issue == "IMBAL_INCOME" ~ gap_text(
      paste("Revenue less cost of sales", money(revenue - cost_of_sales, unit)),
      paste("gross profit", money(gross_profit, unit)),
      revenue - cost_of_sales - gross_profit, revenue, "revenue", unit),
    issue == "IMBAL_PROFIT" ~ gap_text(
      paste("Result before tax less tax", money(pretax - income_tax +
                                                  coalesce(profit_discontinued, 0), unit)),
      paste("result", money(profit, unit)),
      pretax - income_tax + coalesce(profit_discontinued, 0) - profit,
      revenue, "revenue", unit),
    issue == "IMBAL_CASHFLOW" ~ gap_text(
      paste("Three cash flows", money(flows, unit)),
      paste("movement in cash", money(coalesce(before_fx, cash_change), unit)),
      coalesce(before_fx, cash_change) - flows, assets, "total assets", unit),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(detail)) %>%
  select(filing, issue, gap_detail = detail)

screen_titles <- c(
  scale = "A prior-year figure off by a factor of 50 or more",
  sign = "A prior-year figure with its sign flipped",
  restated = "A prior-year figure that differs from the one first filed",
  jump = "A figure 50 times its own prior year, or a fiftieth of it",
  currency = "A filing in a currency the issuer uses in no other year",
  identity = "A report of another entity than the one its LEI names")

screens <- screen_rows %>%
  inner_join(filings %>% select(lei, filing, fy), by = c("lei", "filing")) %>%
  mutate(issue = kind, severity = "screen", title = screen_titles[kind])
```

```{r ranking}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One row per issuer
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A concept name is one long word, and a table cannot wrap it: a zero-width
# space before each capital that follows a small letter lets the line break
# there without a visible mark.
breakable <- function(x) gsub("([a-z])([A-Z])", "\\1\u200b\\2", x, perl = TRUE)

# Banks and insurers, found from their own statements: a filer that presents
# a line only a bank or an insurer has is one. The sector factsheet uses the
# same lines. They matter here for the checks of `exempt_for_financials`,
# which fire on a bank's report by construction, and counted they would
# fill the ranking with banks that have done nothing wrong.
# Over the whole lake, since the comparison with the other countries
# applies the same exemption.
financial_all <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "facts")) %>%
  filter(concept %in% financial_concepts) %>%
  distinct(country, lei) %>%
  collect()
financial_leis <- financial_all$lei[financial_all$country == report_country]

# A fault is one check firing on one issuer in one financial year. A report
# filed again for the same year -- a correction, a second language -- has
# the same faults as the first, and counting them per report would rank an
# issuer by how often it re-filed. DUPL_FILING_PERIOD says that it did,
# where the reports differ; DUPL_FILING_COPY, a note that scores nothing,
# where the repository holds one report twice.
faults <- bind_rows(
  issues %>%
    filter(!(issue %in% exempt_for_financials & lei %in% financial_leis)) %>%
    left_join(imbalance_detail, by = c("filing", "issue")) %>%
    group_by(lei, fy, issue, severity = as.character(severity), title) %>%
    summarise(gap_detail = first(na.omit(gap_detail)),
              findings = n(),
              reports = n_distinct(filing),
              concepts = paste(breakable(head(unique(na.omit(sub("^[^:]+:", "", concept))), 3)),
                               collapse = ", "),
              more = pmax(n_distinct(concept, na.rm = TRUE) - 3, 0),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(fact_level = findings > reports,
           detail = case_when(
             !is.na(gap_detail) ~ gap_detail,
             !fact_level ~ "",
             more > 0 ~ paste0(findings, " facts: ", concepts, " and ", more,
                               " more"),
             TRUE ~ paste0(findings, " facts: ", concepts))),
  screens %>%
    group_by(lei, fy, issue, severity, title) %>%
    summarise(findings = n(), reports = n_distinct(filing),
              detail = paste(unique(detail), collapse = "; "),
              .groups = "drop")) %>%
  filter(severity != "info") %>%
  mutate(points = ifelse(severity == "screen", unname(points[issue]),
                         unname(points[severity])),
         kind = tools::toTitleCase(severity)) %>%
  left_join(issuer_names, by = "lei")

issuer_scores <- faults %>%
  group_by(lei) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(points),
            errors = sum(severity == "error"),
            warnings = sum(severity == "warning"),
            screens = sum(severity == "screen"),
            error_points = sum(points * (severity == "error")),
            warning_points = sum(points * (severity == "warning")),
            screen_points = sum(points * (severity == "screen")),
            .groups = "drop")

issuers <- filings %>%
  group_by(lei) %>%
  summarise(years = n_distinct(fy[read]), listed = n(), read = sum(read),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(issuer_names, by = "lei") %>%
  left_join(issuer_scores, by = "lei") %>%
  mutate(across(c(total, errors, warnings, screens, error_points,
                  warning_points, screen_points), ~ coalesce(.x, 0)),
         financial = lei %in% financial_leis) %>%
  filter(read > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(total), desc(errors), issuer)

ranked <- issuers %>% filter(total > 0) %>% head(top_n)

n_issuers_read <- nrow(issuers)
n_with_error <- sum(issuers$errors > 0)
n_clean <- sum(issuers$total == 0)

# The issuer-years with facts, which is what the shares by year are over.
issuer_years <- filings %>%
  filter(read) %>%
  distinct(lei, fy) %>%
  left_join(faults %>%
              group_by(lei, fy) %>%
              summarise(error = any(severity == "error"),
                        screen = any(severity == "screen"),
                        points = sum(points), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("lei", "fy")) %>%
  mutate(error = coalesce(error, FALSE), screen = coalesce(screen, FALSE),
         points = coalesce(points, 0))

rated <- filings %>% filter(read)

# The checks in this country against the rest of the lake, as the share of
# issuer-years each fired in. Both over the issuer-years with facts of the
# financial years shown, and with the same exemption for banks.
others_read <- filings_all %>%
  filter(country != report_country, read, fy %in% report_years)
others_issues <- issues_all %>%
  filter(country != report_country,
         !(issue %in% exempt_for_financials & lei %in% financial_all$lei)) %>%
  inner_join(others_read %>% select(country, lei, filing, fy),
             by = c("country", "lei", "filing"))
n_here <- nrow(issuer_years)
n_there <- nrow(distinct(others_read, lei, fy))
lake_compare <- catalogue %>%
  filter(severity != "info") %>%
  select(issue = code, severity, title) %>%
  left_join(faults %>% filter(severity != "screen") %>% count(issue, name = "here"),
            by = "issue") %>%
  left_join(others_issues %>% distinct(issue, lei, fy) %>% count(issue, name = "there"),
            by = "issue") %>%
  mutate(here = coalesce(here, 0L), there = coalesce(there, 0L),
         here_share = here / n_here * 100,
         there_share = if (n_there > 0) there / n_there * 100 else NA_real_) %>%
  arrange(severity, desc(here_share))
other_countries <- sort(unique(others_read$country))
```

```{r formats}
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & abs(x) < 0.5 / 10^digits, 0, x)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "–",
         formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",",
                 decimal.mark = "."))
}
wrap_caption <- function(text, width = 125) {
  paste(strwrap(text, width = width), collapse = "\n")
}
source_caption <- caption_corporate_design(
  source = paste("ESEF annual financial reports, filings.xbrl.org;",
                 "checks of the fincommons esef module and screens of this",
                 "factsheet."),
  lang = "en")
typst_string <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", x)
  gsub("\"", "\\\\\"", x)
}
ts <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "–", as.character(x))
  paste0("\"", typst_string(x), "\"")
}

# A table written as Typst rather than as a Markdown table, which gives the
# columns the widths they need instead of the ones Pandoc guesses from the
# length of their header. `groups`, where given, names a row that opens a
# group and spans the whole table above the row it is given for.
typst_table <- function(df, widths, align, size = 7.5, groups = NULL) {
  cells <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    row <- paste(ts(unlist(df[i, ], use.names = FALSE)), collapse = ", ")
    if (!is.null(groups) && !is.na(groups[i]) && nzchar(groups[i])) {
      row <- paste0("table.cell(colspan: ", ncol(df),
                    ", inset: (top: 7pt, bottom: 3pt, x: 4pt), text(weight: \"bold\", ",
                    ts(groups[i]), ")), ", row)
    }
    row
  }, character(1))
  paste0(
    "\n```{=typst}\n#block(width: 100%, text(size: ", size, "pt, {\n",
    "set par(justify: false)\ntable(\n",
    "  columns: (", paste(widths, collapse = ", "), "),\n",
    "  align: (", paste(align, collapse = ", "), "),\n",
    "  inset: (x: 4pt, y: 2.8pt),\n",
    "  stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { (top: 0.7pt + rgb(\"#22282E\"), ",
    "bottom: 0.4pt + rgb(\"#22282E\")) } else { none },\n",
    "  table.header(", paste0("text(weight: \"bold\", ", ts(names(df)), ")",
                             collapse = ", "), "),\n  ",
    paste(cells, collapse = ",\n  "),
    ",\n  table.hline(stroke: 0.7pt + rgb(\"#22282E\"))\n)}))\n```\n\n")
}

cols <- design_colours()
severity_colours <- c("Error" = cols[["red"]], "Warning" = cols[["amber"]],
                      "Screen" = cols[["blue"]])
```

```{r cover, results='asis'}
title <- paste("ESEF data quality in", country_name)
subtitle <- paste0("Which issuers' figures to check before using them, ",
                   "financial years ", period_range)

tile <- function(value, label, colour) {
  paste0("box(width: 100%, inset: (x: 8pt, y: 7pt), stroke: (left: 2pt + rgb(\"",
         colour, "\")), [#text(size: 17pt, weight: \"bold\", ", ts(value),
         ")\\ #text(size: 7.5pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"), ", ts(label), ")])")
}

worst <- ranked %>% head(5)
lines <- c(
  paste0(fmt(n_issuers_read), " issuers of ", country_name, " filed ",
         fmt(nrow(rated)), " ESEF reports with facts for the financial years ",
         period_range, "."),
  paste0(fmt(n_with_error), " of them (", fmt(n_with_error / n_issuers_read * 100),
         " %) have at least one year whose figures contradict one another, ",
         "and ", fmt(n_clean), " have nothing found at all."),
  if (nrow(worst) > 0) paste0("The most to check is in the reports of ",
         paste(worst$issuer, collapse = "; "), "."))

cat("```{=typst}\n")
cat("#set page(header: [#set text(size: 7pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"))\n",
    "  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), [#text(weight: \"bold\", ",
    ts(paste("ESEF data quality ·", Country_name)), ") #h(6pt) #text(",
    ts(paste("Financial years", period_range)), ")], [#text(",
    ts(paste("Checked on", format(checked_on, "%d %B %Y"))), ")])\n",
    "  #v(-4pt) #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb(\"#DCE1E5\"))],\n",
    "  footer: [#set text(size: 7pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"))\n",
    "  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb(\"#DCE1E5\")) #v(-2pt)\n",
    "  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), [#text(",
    ts("Source: filings.xbrl.org; checks of the fincommons esef module. Not a finding of any regulator."),
    ")], [#context counter(page).display()])],\n  numbering: \"1\")\n", sep = "")
cat("#text(size: 8pt, tracking: 1.6pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"), ",
    ts(toupper(paste("Data quality factsheet ·", Country_name))), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("#v(2pt)\n#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + rgb(\"#C10016\"))\n#v(8pt)\n")
cat("#text(size: 21pt, weight: \"bold\", ", ts(title), ")\n#v(1pt)\n", sep = "")
cat("#text(size: 10pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"), ", ts(subtitle), ")\n#v(10pt)\n", sep = "")
cat("#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 8pt,\n  ",
    tile(fmt(n_issuers_read), "issuers with facts", cols[["ink"]]), ",\n  ",
    tile(fmt(nrow(rated)), "reports read", cols[["ink"]]), ",\n  ",
    tile(paste0(fmt(mean(issuer_years$error) * 100), " %"),
         "of issuer-years with an error", cols[["red"]]), ",\n  ",
    tile(paste0(fmt(mean(issuer_years$screen) * 100), " %"),
         "of issuer-years a screen flagged", cols[["blue"]]),
    "\n)\n#v(8pt)\n", sep = "")
cat("```\n\n")
cat(paste(lines, collapse = " "), "\n\n")

# The reports whose figures should not be used at all, whatever their rank:
# a report under someone else's LEI and a report in a currency the issuer
# does not report in are wrong as a whole rather than in one line, and an
# issuer with one such report and nothing else would not reach the ranking.
set_aside <- bind_rows(
  identity %>%
    inner_join(filings %>% select(filing, fy), by = "filing") %>%
    distinct(lei, fy, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(text = paste0("**", short_name(name, 60), "**, ", fy, ": the report ",
                            "names itself *", substr(stated, 1, 60), "*. ",
                            "It is filed under another entity's LEI.")),
  currency_breaks %>%
    inner_join(filings %>% select(filing, fy), by = "filing") %>%
    left_join(issuer_names, by = "lei") %>%
    distinct(lei, fy, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(text = paste0("**", issuer, "**, ", fy, ": reported in ", currency,
                            ", while the issuer's other reports are in ",
                            usual, ".")))
if (nrow(set_aside) > 0) {
  cat("```{=typst}\n#block(width: 100%, inset: (x: 9pt, y: 7pt), ",
      "stroke: (left: 2pt + rgb(\"", cols[["red"]], "\")), ",
      "fill: rgb(\"#FBF3F4\"))[\n", sep = "")
  cat("```\n\n")
  cat("**Reports to set aside.** These are wrong as a whole rather than in ",
      "one line, so their figures should not be used at all.\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(paste0("- ", set_aside$text, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
  cat("```{=typst}\n]\n```\n\n")
}
```

detail_issuers <- head(ranked$lei, detail_n)
temp <- faults %>%

  mutate(order = match(lei, detail_issuers)) %>%
  arrange(order, desc(fy), match(severity, c("error", "warning", "screen")),
          issue) %>%

         Detail = ifelse(reports > 1 & severity != "screen",
                         paste0("In ", reports, " reports",
                                ifelse(detail == "", "", paste0("; ", detail))),
                         detail))
if (nrow(temp) == 0) {
  cat("Nothing to list.\n")
} else {
  cat(typst_table(temp %>% transmute(Year = as.character(fy), Kind = kind,
                                     Check = issue, Finding = title, Detail),
                  widths = c("auto", "auto", "auto", "1fr", "1fr"),
                  align = rep("left", 5), size = 7, groups = temp$group))
  cat(paste0("The ", min(detail_n, nrow(ranked)), " issuers ranked highest, ",
             "every finding of theirs in ", period_range, ". For a figure ",
             "that changed between reports, the year is that of the later ",
             "report, the one that states the figure differently, which is ",
             "not necessarily the one that is wrong.\n"))
}
```

## How to read this factsheet

```{r notes, results='asis'}
notes <- c(
  paste0("**What it reads.** The tables of filings, facts and issues of the ",
         "`esef` module of fincommons. The issues are written by the ",
         fmt(nrow(catalogue)), " checks of `fincommons.financialreport.esef.quality`, ",
         "last run over ", country_name, " on ", format(checked_on, "%d %B %Y"),
         "; this factsheet does not re-run them. The screens are its own."),
  paste0("**What a finding means.** A record that failed a check of this ",
         "project -- not a finding of a regulator, and not a statement that a ",
         "figure is wrong. An *error* is a contradiction an analysis cannot ",
         "read past, such as a balance sheet that does not balance. A ",
         "*warning* needs a look before the figures are used. The data ",
         "quality report of the module sets out every check and what it ",
         "does not mean."),
  paste0("**The screens.** The checks look at one report at a time; the ",
         "screens set an issuer's reports beside one another, on ",
         paste(unname(screen_concepts), collapse = ", "), ". A report's ",
         "figure for the year before is compared with the figure that ",
         "year's own report gave. A difference above ",
         fmt(restated_tolerance * 100), " % is a *restatement*, which a new ",
         "standard or a discontinued operation explains as often as a ",
         "mistake does, and scores ", points[["restated"]], " point. A ",
         "factor of ", scale_factor, " or more is a *scale* break -- almost ",
         "always thousands tagged as units, or the reverse -- and a flipped ",
         "sign a *sign* break; both score ", points[["scale"]], ". A *jump* ",
         "is the same factor between the two years of one report, and a ",
         "*currency* break a report in a currency the issuer uses in no ",
         "other year. An *identity* break is a report whose own statement of ",
         "the entity's name has nothing in common with the name of the LEI it ",
         "is filed under, where no other report under that LEI matches ",
         "either: a filing agent's test report, or an issuer's report filed ",
         "under the LEI of whoever submitted it. A figure tagged twice with two values is left out of ",
         "the screens, since which value is meant cannot be told."),
  paste0("**The size of a gap.** Where an arithmetic check fired, the detail ",
         "pages give the two sides of the identity, the gap between them and ",
         "the gap as a share of total assets, or of revenue for the income ",
         "statement. The figures are read as the check reads them: the ",
         "report's own year, without dimensions. A small gap is often one ",
         "line left out; a gap the size of a whole side is a figure tagged ",
         "with the wrong concept or the wrong scale, or a statement laid out ",
         "differently from what the identity assumes."),
  paste0("**What the ranking is.** Points per issuer over the years shown. ",
         "Each check counts once per issuer and financial year, however many ",
         "facts or reports it names: ", points[["error"]], " for an error, ",
         points[["warning"]], " for a warning, nothing for a note. ",
         "MISS_REVENUE and IMBAL_ASSETS are not counted for the ",
         fmt(length(financial_leis)), " issuers that present the lines of a ",
         "bank or an insurer: their revenue is interest or premium income and ",
         "is tagged as such, and their assets are presented by liquidity or ",
         "with the bank's as a block of their own. The weights are a judgement, set at the top ",
         "of the template; an issuer reporting in more years has more chances ",
         "to score, so the years are given beside the points."),
  paste0("**What it does not say.** A report with no finding has passed ",
         "these checks, not an audit. An identity can only fail where a ",
         "report tags both its sides, so a report that tags little passes by ",
         "silence; the MISS_ checks are what show that. Reports listed ",
         "without facts (", fmt(sum(!filings$read)), " here) are outside ",
         "every share above."),
  paste0("This factsheet is produced by a template of the open-source ",
         "project fincommons. It reads a public record, is given without ",
         "warranty as to correctness or completeness, and carries no ",
         "association with the issuers, with XBRL International or with ESMA."))
cat(paste(notes, collapse = "\n\n"))
```
